blocks.content:
Indian citizenship can be lost in three ways:
• Renunciation – voluntarily giving up citizenship
• Termination – acquiring foreign citizenship
• Deprivation – forced removal by government in certain cases

items: Distinguish between Renunciation (voluntary) and Deprivation (forced removal by the government).
Termination is triggered specifically by acquiring foreign citizenship.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Indian citizenship can be lost through three distinct modes.
Renunciation involves voluntarily giving up citizenship.
Termination occurs upon acquiring foreign citizenship.
Deprivation is the forced removal of citizenship by the government in certain cases.
